courses.summary: 拉斯坦努拉是沙烏地阿拉伯歷史悠久的煉油設施；本課將新舊設備接口、品質帳和檢驗趨勢放在一起分析。本課依序分析原料到產品分率、批次品質混合、換熱網路基準、長期壁厚趨勢、設備更新停機窗口，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Ras Tanura is a long-established Saudi refinery; this case combines old/new equipment interfaces, quality balances and inspection trends. The course analyses feed-to-product fractions, batch-quality blending, heat-network baseline, long-term thickness trend, outage windows for equipment renewal, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
